layouts.name: Silvies Valley Craddock
layouts.scorecard_source: Yardages, handicaps and ratings: GolfPass, The Retreat & Links at Silvies Valley Ranch - Craddock Course, scorecard and layout (read 2026-10-25); every row adds up to its Out/In/Total; ratings for White, Grey and Black only. Par: the club's Craddock map (release silvies-data craddock.webp): hole 1 par 5, hole 5 par 4 (520 yd), par 71; GolfPass has both par 5 (72), OSM has 1 par 4 and 5 par 5 (developer 2026-10-25: use the club map). The map's three yardage columns match GolfPass Challenge/Grey/Black except holes 1 and 9 (map 490/425 vs Grey 455/350) and 6 (map 345 vs Black 325): open item. Unverified (no printed card).

layouts.name: Silvies Valley Hankins
layouts.scorecard_source: GolfPass, The Retreat & Links at Silvies Valley Ranch - Hankins Course, scorecard and layout (read 2026-10-25): all seven sets, men's handicaps, ratings for White, Grey and Black only; every column adds up (par 72; GolfPass's tee table says 73). The club's Hankins map (release silvies-data Hankins.webp) prints White/Grey/Black and agrees, except that its hole 3 row repeats hole 2. Pink 8 (465) is longer than White 8 (410) on the card. Unverified (third party).

layouts.name: Silvies Valley Chief Egan
layouts.scorecard_source: Yardages: the club's Chief Egan map (release silvies-data chief.egan.webp) and GolfPass (the same 875 yd). Par: the club map (holes 3 and 6 par 4: par 29; GolfPass lists every hole par 3, 27; same rule as Craddock, developer 2026-10-25). Handicaps: GolfPass. No rating.

notes: Three layouts in one world (developer 2026-10-25): Craddock (the OSM hole lines), Hankins (Craddock's fairways played the other way, 9 greens of its own) and Chief Egan (the 9-hole short course round the east pond). McVeigh's Gauntlet (7 holes on the south edge, partly outside the boundary) is not built. Tees: the back set on the club maps (developer 2026-10-25, overriding the 6,300 yd default): Craddock Challenge 7,170, Hankins White 7,075, Chief Egan White 875. Standing defaults otherwise:, all water red, OB = the OSM boundary grown 30 m round Craddock play (approved 2026-10-25), the practice strip by the lodge stays in play (developer: no need to make it OB), wind 1-7 mph, theme silvies (new).
